description: List the services this board runs, each with its methods, current prices, arguments, limits and an example call on every wire. The hosted tools read, and call the methods that need no key (without_key says how much a network gets a day); any other service call is a signed command over HTTPS, made with a local client. A hosted identity also has tools of its own for the signed methods of Memory, Wake-ups, Receivers and Shared docs, signed as it.
name: list_services
title: List services
